note: Triennial election of Irvinestown Rural District Council, nineteen divisions, one member each. The Impartial Reporter of 4 May 1933, p. 5, reports the nominations: 'In the Irvinestown District there will be no contest. The following have been returned', with every division and member. Filed on 1933-05-31, the county's polling day that year (confirmed). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Innishmacsaint' to Inishmacsaint (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Inishmacsaint; the rounds were filed as Innishmacsaint (1927, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1961, 1964); Innismacsaint (1939, 1946, 1949, 1952); Inishmacsaint (1955, 1958). This round was filed as 'Innishmacsaint', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (innishmacsaint) answers with a redirect to this one.
